results.content:
. Every data API has blind spots because each provider sees a different slice of the web, so I overlap as many providers as I could wire in and one covers what another misses.

I was also annoyed that deep research wasn’t durable, so Hyperresearch keeps every source a run reads and you can search it later and build on your research instead of starting over.

What’s in it:

   Research reports. Deep Search takes 3 to 5 hours across about 150 to 200 sources, and every cited claim is double-checked against its source before the report ships.

   A source vault. The sources a run reads stay in your workspace, searchable by words or meaning, from the console or MCP. [...] Upvote

Ishan Roy

What I found really interesting was the in video search feature. Most UGC platforms just show you the video and then you still have to watch through it yourself to figure out whether it’s actually useful or not. But breaking the video down into separate layers like visuals, audio, and text, and then making specific moments searchable feels like a much smarter way to handle it.I was wondering about the sentiment analysis part though. How well does it work when the person in the video is being sarcastic or has a really mixed opinion? That kind of nuance usually seems pretty hard for AI systems to fully understand.
